name: mexico-used-gaming-buyback-platform
description: Reverse E-Commerce Buyback Platform for Video Games, Consoles and Retro CRT TVs in Mexico (MERN Stack)

scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
